name: Varok Saurfang
summary: In Orgrimmar, Varok Saurfang commands the Horde's forces under Warchief Thrall. He brings the strength and hard-won experience of the Old Horde's wars to the young Horde.

sections.title: A Living Legend of the Wars
sections.body: Varok Saurfang carries the Old Horde's wars into the present. Few living warriors can match his record, and many regard him as unstoppable in battle. As High Overlord in Orgrimmar, he helps hold together Thrall's newborn Horde.

sections.title: The Weight of the Blood
sections.body: Varok Saurfang defends the Horde and enforces Thrall's rule against threats. He does not seek battle for its own sake. He despises warmongering and fights for honor and the Horde's survival.

faq.answer: Varok Saurfang is a renowned orc warrior and Warchief Thrall's chief military commander in the Horde.

faq.q: What wars did Saurfang fight in?
aliases: did saurfang fight in the first war
faq.answer: Varok Saurfang fought in the Old Horde's wars against the Alliance. Now he fights for Thrall's Horde.

faq.q: How does Saurfang view the Horde's past?
aliases: why does saurfang regret the past
faq.answer: Varok Saurfang fought for the Old Horde in the days of the demon blood curse. Now he serves Thrall's Horde, which has turned from that path.

faq.q: What is Saurfang's role in the current Horde?
faq.answer: Varok Saurfang leads Thrall's forces as High Overlord. He oversees military readiness, enforces the Warchief's commands, and mentors younger Horde warriors.

angles.text: As an orc, you can look to High Overlord Saurfang as a model of martial strength and a reminder of the spiritual cost of the demonic blood curse.
As a warrior, you can revere Saurfang as a veteran without peer. His skill with an axe, tactical brilliance, and resolve embody the ideal soldier.
